metaTitle: Tirrategin n Hanibal — Trebya, Trasimen, Kannas, Zama
metaDesc: Tuffriwin, akal, asali n telɣut d snat n tɣelfin yettwaẕẕayen: timenɣiwin n Hanibal ttusfehment s yiskanen, seg Trebya ar Zama, d lwert-nsent deg tesdawiyin n umennuɣ.
title: Taẓuri n umennuɣ ɣef leḥsab n Hanibal
lede: Tuffriwin, akal, asali n telɣut d uẖaṣer: seld 22 n leqṛun, tesdawiyin n uɛesskar mazal-itent ttɣaren timenɣiwin-is.
heroAlt: John Trumbull — Lmut n Paul Emile deg temenɣut n Kannas
heroCap: J. Trumbull — Lmut n Paul Emile di Kannas (1773)
trapsSub: Tegrest n 218 akked tefsut n 217 uqbel Ɛisa — ɣef leḥsab n Bulib d Titus Livyus
trebia.aria: Askan n temenɣut n Trebya: Iṛumaniyen zegren asif ijamden ttnaɣen aɛesskar n Hanibal, skud Magun, yeffer deg uɣezdis, yehudd-iten seg deffir.
trebia.title: Aman ijamden d tuffra
trebia.text: Ɣer tafrara, iɛeskriyen inumidiyen ɣef wuyis sselɣun Iṛumaniyen, zegren asif ijamden s tɛebbuḏ tilemt. Ɛemmden, qablen aɛesskar yesteɛfan; 2 000 n yergazen n Magun, yeffren deg uɣezdis, ffɣen-d ɣer deffir-nsen.
trebia.facts.0.v: Hanibal; gma-s Magun yeffer akked 1 000 n yiɛeskriyen uḍaren ifaẓen akked 1 000 ɣef wuyis ifaẓen.
trebia.facts.1.v: Aqunṣul Tiberius Sempronius Longus, iḥeṛṣ ɣef umennuɣ; amdakel-is Scipiyun, yettwajreḥ di Tessinu kra n dduṛan uqbel-agi.
trebia.facts.2.v: Ɣer 10 000 n Iṛumaniyen zegren tlemmast, rewlen ɣer Plaisance; ayen i d-yeqqimen n uɛesskar yettwahudd neɣ yemẖeṣreq (Bulib).
trasimene.aria: Askan n temenɣut n ugelmam n Trasimen: aḍhur aṛumi ittnuzgen ger agelmam d yidurar anida yeffer uɛesskar n Hanibal; anekcum d tuffeg n uɣilif mdelen.
trasimene.title: Aɛesskar ummid deg usigna
trasimene.text: Aḍhur n uqunṣul Flaminyus ikcem ɣer rrif aḥeṛci, ger agelmam d yidurar. Deg usigna, Hanibal yemdel anekcum d tuffeg, sakin yehudd seg yal tama. Ttwaḥebsen zdat waman, Iṛumaniyen ur zemmren ara ad ferqen.
trasimene.facts.0.v: Ɣer 55 000 n yergazen yeffren ɣef yidurar, deg usigna n tfurar, hudden deg yiwet n tsarutt ɣef tɣezfa meṛṛa n uḍhur.
trasimene.facts.1.v: Ɣer 30 000 n yilijyuner n uqunṣul Caius Flaminius, deg uḍhur n tikli, ur nfeṛq ara i umennuɣ.
trasimene.facts.2.v: Deg tlata isragen, ɣer 15 000 n Iṛumaniyen ttwanɣan, gar-asen Flaminyus; aṭas ɣemqen mi rewlen. 6 000 n yergazen i gezgren ttuɣalen ɣer deffir deg wass i d-iteddun. Ṛuma tesers Fabius Maximus d adiktatur: ad yemneɛ seg umennuɣ seg imiren, d wayen i d-yefkan isem-is « Cunctator », Amseɛraq.
cannae.title: Kannas, deg tlata n tikwal
cannae.sub: 2 ɣuct 216 uqbel Ɛisa — ɣer 50 000 n Iqarṭaǧiyen mgal 86 000 n Iṛumaniyen
cannae.aria: Askan s umussu n temenɣut n Kannas
cannae.phases.0.title: Aggur
cannae.phases.0.text: Deg tlemmast, Igaliyen d Iberiyen kecmen deg tɣenjawt tenfeɣ ɣer zdat, ɣer ilijyun. Ilibiyen, tifaẓt, ṭṭfen deg deffir ɣef snat n tɣelfin.
cannae.phases.0.more: Tiɣrit-agi, i gettwaxtaren akken ad tili d tarurant ɣer leqdic, tettwasnulfa ad tuɣal ɣer deffir ddawt n ttaẓ aṛumi. Hanibal akked gma-s Magun ttnaɣen s yiman-nsen deg tlemmast, ɣef leḥsab n Bulib.
cannae.phases.1.title: Asaruẓ yettwaxemmemen
cannae.phases.1.text: Tlemmast tuɣal ɣer deffir war ma teṭṭuṛṛu, tesmagar-d ilijyun, yettraḥmen. Deg wakud-agi, aɛesskar n Hasdrubal ɣef wuyis isseṭṭaṛ wid n Ṛuma ɣef rrif n Aufide.
cannae.phases.1.more: Kemmel Iṛumaniyen kecmen, kemmel tarbaɛt-nsen teẕẕay: deg tlemmast, ilijyuner ur zemmren ara ad seqdacen leslaḥ-nsen. Snat n tɣelfin n yiɛeskriyen Ilibiyen iẖeṣnen, ur nettwaẕẕi ara, qqimen ɣef tɣelfin-nsen.
cannae.phases.2.title: Aḥbul yemdel
cannae.phases.2.text: Ilibiyen zzin wten tiɣelfin, aɛesskar ɣef wuyis yuɣal yewta Iṛumaniyen seg deffir. D « snat n tɣelfin yettwaẕẕayen », mazal-itt ttusfehmet ar assa.
cannae.phases.2.more: Aɛesskar aqarṭaǧi ɣef wuyis, seld ma yesseṭṭaṛ win n Ṛuma, yehudd deffir n yiɛeskriyen uḍaren iṛumaniyen. Aẕẕi yemmid; aqunṣul Paul Emile yettwanɣa.
cannae.stats.0.t: Iqarṭaǧiyen: Igaliyen d Iberiyen deg tlemmast, iɛeskriyen uḍaren ileqqḍen Ilibiyen ɣef tɣelfin, aɛesskar ɣef wuyis iberiyen, igaliyen d inumidiyen
cannae.stats.1.t: Iṛumaniyen d yimɛawanen-nsen: 8 n yilijyun akked waṭas n yimɛawanen, ttraḥmen deg telqey deg tlemmast, aɛesskar ɣef wuyis ɣef tɣelfin
cannae.stats.2.t: n Iṛumaniyen yettwanɣan ɣef leḥsab n yiɣbula
cannae.stats.3.t: n yimttanen n Usqamu neɣ iqeḍyan iqdimen i yettwanɣan, ɣef leḥsab n Titus Livyus
cannae.result: Lfer ummid n Qarṭaǧ akked yiwen seg yixsiren ibaṛazen deg umezruy n Ṛuma. Ɣef leḥsab n Titus Livyus, Magun issers zdat Usqamu n Qarṭaǧ ibzimen n ddheb yettwakksen seg iɛeskriyen ɣef wuyis iṛumaniyen yemmuten. Tirrategt n snat n tɣelfin yettwaẕẕayen teqqim d lemtel deg tesdawiyin n uɛesskar.
zama.title: Zama, lmeslaḥa tettwaqleb
zama.sub: Tubeṛ 202 uqbel Ɛisa — Scipiyun mgal Hanibal, di Tafrikt
zama.aria: Askan n temenɣut n Zama: ilfan n Hanibal ɛeddan deg yiberdan i d-yeqqimen ger tɣelfin n Iṛumaniyen, sakin aɛesskar n Lelyus akked Masinisa ɣef wuyis uɣalen wten deffir aqarṭaǧi.
zama.carthage: Ɣer 36 000 n iɛeskriyen uḍaren, 4 000 ɣef wuyis akked 80 n ilfan. Aɛesskar ur yemsaweɣ ara: iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen, isegmanen ifriqiyen akked, deg tmendawt, iqeddimen n Italya.
zama.rome: Ɣer 30 000 ar 35 000 n iɛeskriyen uḍaren akked 6 000 ar 9 000 ɣef wuyis, gar-asen Inumidiyen n Masinisa: ilijyun ifaẓen akked uɛesskar ɣef wuyis ifaẓen ugar.
zama.phases.0.title: Sseqḍaɛ ilfan
zama.phases.0.text: Scipiyun yesger tiɣelfin-is, yeǧǧa-d iberdan. Ssuḏent-ten taɣenjawt, ilfan ɛeddan war aẖsaṛan neɣ ẕẕin wten Iqarṭaǧiyen.
zama.phases.1.title: Asenhal n yiɛeskriyen uḍaren
zama.phases.1.text: Snat n tɣelfin tiqarṭaǧiyin timezwura, iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen sakin isegmanen, ttusuffɣent ɣer deffir. Iqeddimen n Hanibal ṭṭfen: amennuɣ iḥerca, ur yefri ara.
zama.phases.2.title: Aɛesskar ɣef wuyis ifra
zama.phases.2.text: Seld ma sseṭṭaṛen aɛesskar aqarṭaǧi ɣef wuyis, Lelyus d Masinisa uɣalen wten deffir n Hanibal: tirrategt n Kannas, tettwaqleb fell-as.
zama.result: Lfer aṛumi ifran. Qarṭaǧ texṣeṛ amennuɣ, ilaq-as ad teqbel talwit iḥeṛcen; Hanibal yeqbel axsaṛan, inṣiḥ s yiman-is i Usqamu ad t-yeqbel.
weapons.0.alt: Goya — Hanibal yettwali Italya seg idurar n Alpes
weapons.0.title: Akal
weapons.0.text: Asif ijamden di Trebya, agelmam d yidurar di Trasimen: d netta i gettaẖtaren amkan n temenɣut assaɣen.
weapons.1.title: Tuffra
weapons.1.text: Magun yeffer deg uɣezdis di Trebya, aɛesskar ummid deg usigna di Trasimen.
weapons.2.title: Asali n telɣut
weapons.2.text: Ismaɣan d ineḍṛen; iẖeddem ṭṭbiɛa n iqunṣulen, iseqdac aḥerṣ-nsen.
weapons.3.title: Aɛesskar ɣef wuyis
weapons.3.text: Inumidiyen d Iberiyen, irurad d yimussanen: ifran-d ɣef tɣelfin akked deg uwetta n deffir.
weapons.4.alt: Aɛesskar n Hanibal deg idurar n Alpes
weapons.4.title: Tiddukla
weapons.4.text: Ilibiyen, Inumidiyen, Iberiyen, Igaliyen: aɛesskar n waṭas n yigduden yeqqimen ddukklen sḏis mraw iseggasen deg tmurt n ucengu.
schools.title: Yettwaselmed deg tesdawiyin n umennuɣ
schools.text: Deg tirrategt, « xdem Kannas » yuɣal d tanfalit ummid i uẕẕi n uɛesskar.
schools.items.0.p: Anmhal n ustaf isuffeɣ-d tirebbuɛt n tezrawin s yisem « Cannae »; aɣawas-is n ukcum n 1914 yemmagar-it s telqey.
schools.items.1.p: Kannas tella d tamenɣut i gesmenyafen anmhal n umennuɣ n Lxlij (1991) asmi yella d anelmad.
schools.items.2.p: Yeḥsab Hanibal d yiwen seg yiqayden ibaṛazen aṭas, iɣra tinekra-ines send ad yezger netta daɣen idurar n Alpes, ɣer Grand-Saint-Bernard.
schools.items.3.p: Akken ad yemneɛ seg Hanibal, Fabius yeǧǧa amennuɣ. Tirrategt-ines « tafabit » tefka-d isem-is armi i tejmaɛt tabritanit Fabian Society.

links.0.text: Seg Qarṭaǧant ɣer Zama, tudert n unmhal i gesseẖzen Ṛuma.

links.1.text: Seg Ṛun ɣer idurar n Alpes: 37 n ilfan akked uɛesskar ummid mgal idurar.
